name: Virulent Toxins
body:
Your study into the field of toxicology has made your toxins ignore common defenses.

Prerequisite(s): Toxicologist alchemical discipline class feature, alchemist 7th.

Benefit(s): Whenever a creature must make a saving throw against one of your toxins, that creature cannot benefit from racial or circumstance bonuses to poison effects (this does not interact with poison immunity).
